blocks.downstream_mixing: the shared mass-balance operator built on that field, by one function for every lane. Derived. On a ContamX lane it is not an independent ContamX result: recirculated legs come from declared outdoor-air fraction applied to solved terminal flow.
blocks.solved_airflow: sums over the lane's own airflow field: ContamX solved Flow0 and dP; on the native lane the prescribed flows (labelled prescribed, not solved). outdoor_air_total_m3h and exhaust_total_m3h are blank with status unimplemented on a ContamX lane whenever every AHS system path reports Flow0 = 0; a solver-path zero is not a physical zero.

canary.note: row IDs, hulls, lanes, settings and repetitions are the frozen matrix, unchanged. The in-job configuration smoke adds one untimed solve per executed ContamX row (53); these are reported separately and are not among the 318 planned timed invocations.

contamx.license: NIST software, 17 U.S.C. 105: not subject to copyright, public domain; NIST states it can be redistributed freely (https://www.nist.gov/services-resources/software/contam, read 2026-11-19). Staged only in the private campaign bucket; not committed and not published.

gates.ahs_group_count_matches: AHS group count equals hvac_zones count
gates.authored_reference_solved_as_committed: the authored lane solves the committed platform.prj bytes (SHA-256 equal to the input manifest)
gates.cell_completed: every executed row's smoke cell finishes
gates.design_and_solver_pinned: frozen design files, criteria and ContamX executable match their SHA-256 pins (runner, fatal)
gates.duty_ach_exported: exported declared terminal supply over baseline equals the factor within export_factor_rel
gates.duty_ach_realized: realized supply_total over lane baseline equals the factor (native_factor_rel; ContamX solved terminals solved_factor_rel)
gates.effective_oa_realized: on native and harmonized ContamX rows, effective_outdoor_air_fraction_of_supply read from the operator's legs equals the declared fraction weighted by declared supply, within native_oa_abs or contamx_oa_abs
gates.failure: any failed gate stops the stage before timing; nothing is fixed by editing hull files, the matrix or the canary set
gates.inputs_unchanged: every canary hull input and shared input matches the manifest before and after the run (runner, fatal)
gates.oa_change_is_the_only_operator_change: change in clean_air_equivalent_with_filter equals -(1 - filter efficiency) x change in recirculated legs within operator_tie_rel
gates.oa_only_terminal_flow_unchanged: on outdoor-air rows, realized supply_total and return_total equal the lane baseline within unchanged_rel
gates.oa_setting_reaches_mixing: on outdoor-air rows, effective_outdoor_air_fraction_of_supply moves by more than oa_response_abs from baseline
gates.path_map_matches_solved_paths: path-map entry count equals solved path count
gates.unsupported_is_blank_not_zero: a metric has a number if and only if its status is ok
gates.weather_applied_in_solver: at wind_speed_10 the solved field digest differs from baseline and some solved_airflow aggregate moves by more than unchanged_rel
gates.weather_record_exported: Ws/Wd of the exported steady weather record equal the level
gates.wind_profile_paths_present: the path map has at least one envelope or ambient-opening path on a weather row
gates.zones_equal_across_lanes: zone count equal and total volume within volume_rel of the hull's native baseline

downstream_mixing.clean_air_equivalent_no_filter_m3h: tracer leaving the hull per unit uniform concentration with no filter credit: return legs minus recirculated legs plus sinks
downstream_mixing.clean_air_equivalent_with_filter_m3h: the same read from the operator itself (-1'AV), lane filter efficiency 0.3 included
downstream_mixing.effective_outdoor_air_fraction_of_supply: outdoor_air_derived over delivered supply; the realized effective mixing
downstream_mixing.nonrecirculated_return_m3h: return legs minus recirculated legs (derived exhaust equivalent)
downstream_mixing.operator_parts_residual_m3h: operator value minus the sum of its parts
downstream_mixing.return_leg_total_m3h, recirculated_suppl: sums of the operator's room-to-plenum and plenum-to-room legs
downstream_mixing.uniform_tracer_material_time_h: time integral of whole-hull tracer mass over 12 h divided by initial mass; uniform start, no decay

solved_airflow.ahs_system_path_count, ahs_system_path_n: count of AHS outdoor-air, exhaust and recirculation paths, and how many carry nonzero solved flow
solved_airflow.ambient_inward_total_m3h / ambient_outwa: sums over non-AHS paths between a zone and ambient, by solved direction (native: declared exchange counts in both)
solved_airflow.hull_balance_residual_m3h: sum over zones of net volumetric inflow: boundary inward minus outward plus supply minus return terminals. Redefined from the protocol's boundary-only wording because the AHS ambient paths are unresolved; near 0 for a converged ContamX field
solved_airflow.max_abs_zone_balance_residual_m3h: largest absolute zone net inflow; value only
solved_airflow.pressure_abs_dp_*_pa, pressure_rows_unso: over every mapped path; ContamX lanes only
solved_airflow.return_total_m3h: sum of AHS return terminal flow, exhaust-only branches included
solved_airflow.supply_total_m3h: sum of AHS supply terminal flow (native: delivered flow of positive-duty groups)

observed_status_rules.no_prior_claims: whether the solved field coincides across outdoor-air settings, and whether the tracer metric moves, is read from the run
observed_status_rules.not_executed: structural_nonresponse and not_applicable rows keep their planned status and reason; every value is empty
observed_status_rules.per_block: each row gets one status per block. ok: completed and some metric differs from the lane baseline by more than unchanged_rel (baseline rows are ok). unchanged: completed and every numeric metric of that block is within unchanged_rel of the lane baseline; measured, never assumed.

reported_not_gated: supply_ach_x1p5 against supply_duty_x1p5 per lane; a difference beyond unchanged_rel is a finding
harmonized against as-committed and authored baselines, shown separately and never pooled
max_abs_zone_balance_residual_m3h and hull_balance_residual_m3h of each field
identity of metrics and field digest across warm-up and measured repeats (repeat_metric_rel)
host load average per cell; timings from one Batch attempt on one host
scope: non-biological aggregate engineering and timing only; one value per hull x lane x setting x metric; no zone, path or opening identifier; no ranking; no fleet run

smoke_finding.consequence: In the ContamX lane outdoor-air fraction is realized only in the import-side recirculation synthesis, which is shared model code. The frozen outdoor-air check (exported AHS outdoor-air flow equals declared) is a configuration echo and is replaced below.
smoke_finding.measured: On all four canary hulls, harmonized commissioned export, halving the outdoor-air fraction changes the exported PRJ text and no solved path flow (max |dFlow0| = 0 exactly). ContamX reports Flow0 = 0 on every simple-AHS outdoor-air, exhaust and recirculation path; terminals carry the flow.
smoke_finding.ruling: Benjamin, 2026-11-19: 'Separate solved airflow from downstream mixing, then benchmark both'.

status: frozen before any timed execution; written after the outdoor-air smoke finding and an untimed single-hull mechanics check, before any canary metric table or timing existed

timing.added_phases: input_read (hull documents from disk), field_reduce (solved_airflow sums) and process_total (interpreter start to exit, measured by the driver) are recorded as extra phases; downstream is the downstream_mixing computation
timing.host: one AWS Batch job, not an array; vCPU 1; host, instance type, image and job identifiers recorded in environment.json
timing.unchanged: warm-up 1, measured 5 cold repeats each a fresh interpreter, cached 5 downstream-only repeats in the last measured interpreter; order, clocks, thread settings and summaries as in protocol.json

tolerances.note: 1e-9 values are the protocol's. solved_factor_rel and contamx_oa_abs are new: the solver works in mass flow and the import converts with mean node density, so a solved volumetric ratio is not exact. They were set at 1e-3 before any duty or outdoor-air ratio was measured.

tracer_keep_rule: the uniform inert tracer metric is kept for later stages if tracer_closure passes on every executed canary row; decided from closure only
